peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text (Springer PDF, institutional subscription, read 2026-10-01): Korean fermented anchovy sauce (anchovies with 25% solar sea salt, 10 C, 12-24 months); the paper names no species. Team-lead decision 2026-10-01: a Korean anchovy sauce is read as Engraulis japonicus (WoRMS 219984), the Korean anchovy; the fermented origin is accepted with that note. RP-HPLC peaks I-2/I-3 analysed by ESI-MS/MS and amino acid sequencing; spectra matched the synthetic peptides (Results). Peptides synthesized by Fmoc solid phase (New England Peptide), HPLC-purified, MALDI-TOF mass checked; the four synthetic peptides were assayed because the natural ones co-eluted as a mixture. Assay: Cushman-Cheung, 5 mM HHL, 0.1 M borate pH 8.3 with 0.3 M NaCl, rabbit-lung acetone powder ACE (Sigma), 37 C 1 h, hippuric acid by ethyl acetate extraction at 228 nm. Table 1 IC50 163.51 +- 8.45 uM (abstract and Results: 164 uM).
